name: Sol's RNG
creator: Sol's Studio
redeem: Launch Sol's RNG on Roblox and wait for the game to load.
Click the menu button with three bars on the left side of the screen and open Settings.
Go to the Miscellaneous tab and click Open next to Redeem Code.
Type the code exactly as shown, capital letters included, and click Redeem.
notes:
Sol's RNG is a luck game from Sol's Studio. You press Roll to get a random aura, and each aura has its own rarity, from common ones you see all the time to ones with odds of one in millions. There are more than 400 auras to find. You can craft gear from the auras you collect, drink potions to raise your luck, and wait for special weather and biomes that make certain rare auras possible.

Codes here almost always give Potion Chests and Rare Potion Chests, sometimes with extras like Rainbow Ices, Hwachae or a Power Battery. Save the luck potions from those chests for a special biome or event, since that is when the rarest auras can show up. New codes arrive with most updates and are often named after the update date, and the team also posts sorry codes after server problems.

faq.q: Why do Sol's RNG codes have dates in them, like UPD20260919?
faq.a: Update codes are named after the day the update came out, so UPD20260919 came with the September 19, 2026 update. The older the date, the more likely the code has expired.

faq.q: Where is the code box in Sol's RNG?
faq.a: It is tucked inside the settings. Open the three-bar menu on the left, go to Settings, then Miscellaneous, and click Open next to Redeem Code.

faq.q: When should I drink the potions I get from codes?
faq.a: Wait for a special biome or event, because some of the rarest auras can only roll then. Using luck potions in normal weather still helps, but you get less out of them.

tips: Keep rolling even when you only get common auras. Gear is crafted from the auras you collect, so commons still have a use.
Look at the crafting options once you have a few auras saved. Crafting gear is a big part of getting stronger in Sol's RNG.
Free private servers are available, and the game says they give the best performance. That helps a lot if you plan to roll for a long time.
More rolls means more chances at a rare aura. Long rolling sessions add up, so play when you have time to keep going.
useRewards: The three working codes give 60 Potion Chests and 15 Rare Potion Chests in total, plus 3 Rainbow Ices from SRY4DEALY. Open the chests to see which potions you got, then keep them in your inventory instead of drinking them all at once.
